text: Program Introduction This Program mainly focuses on the Characteristics and the Nondestructive Detection Techniques of Agricultural Products, Functional Components and Extraction Technology of Agricultural Product, the Bioconversion Technology of Agricultural Product, the Reservation of Agricultural Products and the Processing Machine and controlling of agricultural product. In 2008, the project named as “Development of Non-destructive detection for the quality of agricultural products and the sensor information fusion technology” was honored the second prize of National Tech & Invention Award. A Doctoral dissertation titled as “Apple’s quality inspection technology based on the fusion machine vision, electronic nose and NIR spectroscopy” was ranked among the China’s 100 Excellent Doctoral Dissertations in 2008.
